description: This file contains implementation details for string formatting in the Abseil library, including classes and functions for binding format arguments, converting and summarizing format specifications, and outputting formatted strings.

classes.name: ArgContext
classes.description: Helper class to bind format arguments to unbound conversions within a given argument pack.

classes.name: DefaultConverter
classes.description: Default implementation of a converter that outputs formatted data to a sink.

classes.name: SummarizingConverter
classes.description: Converter that summarizes format arguments into a string for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds an unbound conversion to an argument in the pack, resolving width, precision, and flags.

methods.name: ConvertAll
methods.description: Converts all format specifications using a provided converter.

methods.name: FormatUntyped
methods.description: Formats data according to an untyped format specification into a sink.

methods.name: Streamable::Print
methods.description: Outputs the formatted string to an output stream.

methods.name: AppendPack
methods.description: Appends formatted data to a string based on a format spec and argument pack.

methods.name: FormatPack
methods.description: Returns a formatted string based on a format spec and argument pack.

methods.name: FprintF
methods.description: Prints formatted data to a FILE stream.

methods.name: SnprintF
methods.description: Prints formatted data to a character buffer.
